name: NVIDIA NVLink and NVLink Switch product page and specification table
notes: Vendor spec page carrying the authoritative per-generation table: NVLink bandwidth per GPU (900 GB/s Gen4 / 1,800 GB/s Gen5 / 3,000 GB/s Gen6), max links per GPU (18/18/36), GPU domain sizes and total aggregate bandwidth per NVLink Switch generation. Page states figures are preliminary and subject to change. Also the origin of the 'NVLink is a 3 TB/s bidirectional' wording that establishes NVIDIA's per-GPU numbers are bidirectional aggregates.
